Question Choices: Select the correct answer. A quadrilateral has opposite sides parallel and adjacent sides perpendicular, but adjacent sides are unequal in length. What is the most specific name? : Rectangle Rhombus Trapezoid
Hints: Think of a special parallelogram with four right angles.
Solution: Rectangle. All rectangles have two pairs of parallel opposite sides and four right angles.

Question Choices: Fill: A rhombus is always a __
Hints: How many pairs of parallel sides does a rhombus have?
Solution: Parallelogram|parallelogram. A rhombus has two pairs of parallel opposite sides, so it is always a parallelogram.

Question Choices: Is a rhombus always a rectangle? Answer yes or no
Hints: A rectangle must have four right angles.
Solution: no|No. Only when a rhombus has four 90° right angles is it also a rectangle -> then it is a square.

Question Choices: Select True or False of the statement "Every square is a rhombus, but not every rhombus is a square" : TRUE FALSE
Solution: TRUE. Squares have extra rules (four equal sides) that satisfy the rhombus category, but they also require four right angles.

Question Choices: A designer crafts a custom glass window pane with four straight sides. All four sides are exactly equal length, but none of the corners form a 90-degree right angle. What is the most specific name for this window's shape? : Rectangle Rhombus Trapezoid
Hints: Think about a quadrilateral with all sides equal but no right angles.
Solution: Rhombus. All rhombuses have two pairs of parallel sides and all sides equal length.
